pages.title: Rabbit's Quick Tap
pages.markdown: Rabbit tapped lantern one at the forest gate. “Ready!” Rabbit cried. Four lanterns stood on four posts, each number matching its post. Wise Turtle held a small match tin with four dry matches. Neighbors waited nearby with picnic baskets. Rabbit bounced toward the path, eager to lead.
pages.summary: Rabbit declares the path ready while Wise Turtle and the neighbors wait at the gate.
continuityNotes: All four lanterns are on their matching posts.
Wise Turtle has a match tin with four dry matches.
Rabbit, Wise Turtle, and the neighbors are at the forest gate.

pages.title: Turtle's Slow Count
pages.markdown: Wise Turtle checked each number against its post. One, two, three, four. Rabbit wiggled both ears and shuffled one foot. “Can we go now?” Rabbit asked. Turtle touched each sturdy hook before nodding. Picnic baskets rustled behind them as the grass began to bend.
pages.summary: Wise Turtle carefully checks all four lanterns while Rabbit fidgets.
continuityNotes: All four lanterns remain on matching posts.
The neighbors remain together at the gate.
The four-match tin stays with Wise Turtle.

pages.title: Grass Leans Low
pages.markdown: A cool gust swept through the gate. The grass leaned toward the brook, and leaves shivered overhead. Wise Turtle looked along the path. “That wind is growing,” Turtle said. The neighbors drew close beneath the darkening trees. Rabbit stared at the four steady lights.
pages.summary: A rising wind bends the grass toward the brook as the group waits at the gate.
continuityNotes: All four lanterns are still on their matching posts.
Rabbit, Wise Turtle, and the neighbors remain at the gate.
The storm has not yet knocked down the lanterns.

pages.title: Rain on the Leaves
pages.markdown: Rain rattled the leaves. A hard gust swept down the path and knocked every lantern from its post. One, two, three, four went tumbling into the wet grass. Their flames went out. The neighbors huddled together at the gate while the path turned dark.
pages.summary: The storm knocks all four lanterns from their posts and puts out their flames.
continuityNotes: Lanterns one through four are all off their posts and unlit.
The neighbors stay together at the gate.
Wise Turtle still has four dry matches in the match tin.

pages.title: Rabbit Dashes Ahead
pages.markdown: Rabbit saw the dark path and sprang from the gate. “I’ll fix it!” Rabbit called. Wise Turtle began, “Wait. Look where the wind—” But Rabbit’s feet pattered away through the rain. Turtle stayed with the neighbors for a moment, match tin tucked safely away.
pages.summary: Rabbit rushes onto the path alone before Wise Turtle can explain the wind.
continuityNotes: Rabbit leaves the gate and runs onto the lantern path.
Wise Turtle and the neighbors remain at the gate.
All four lanterns are off their posts and unlit.

pages.title: Mud Underfoot
pages.markdown: Rabbit hurried down the muddy path, scanning both sides. Water plopped from fern tips. Behind Rabbit, Wise Turtle started after them at a steady pace, carrying the match tin. The neighbors stayed at the gate. Ahead, four dark lanterns lay scattered beyond the wet grass.
pages.summary: Rabbit searches ahead while Wise Turtle follows from the gate.
continuityNotes: Rabbit is ahead of Wise Turtle on the path.
Wise Turtle has left the gate with the match tin.
The neighbors remain at the gate; all four lanterns are displaced.

pages.title: A Handle by the Brook
pages.markdown: Beside the brook, Rabbit spotted a wet handle shining faintly. It was lantern one. Rabbit lifted it from the grass and shook off a bead of water. The brook burbled beside the path. Lanterns two, three, and four were still somewhere ahead.
pages.summary: Rabbit finds lantern one beside the brook.
continuityNotes: Rabbit holds lantern one beside the brook.
Lanterns two, three, and four remain off their posts.
Wise Turtle follows behind Rabbit on the path.

pages.title: A Number Left Unread
pages.markdown: Rabbit raced to the next hook and hung the lantern there. Its little number faced the post. Rabbit did not look. Lantern one now swung on post two, beside the fern fork. The wet brook glinted behind Rabbit, and the wrong turn began to glow.
pages.summary: Rabbit moves lantern one from the brook to post two without checking its number.
continuityNotes: Lantern one has moved from beside the brook to post two.
Lanterns two, three, and four remain displaced.
Rabbit is beside post two near the fern fork.

pages.title: A Glow at the Fork
pages.markdown: Lantern one glowed at the fern fork, shining toward a side trail. “That was quick!” Rabbit said. Wise Turtle caught up, breathing calmly. Turtle looked from the lantern to the fork. “A bright light can still point the wrong way,” Turtle said. Rabbit had already turned to search.
pages.summary: Wise Turtle reaches Rabbit and sees the misleading glow at the fern fork.
continuityNotes: Lantern one remains on post two.
Rabbit and Wise Turtle are together near the fern fork.
Lanterns two, three, and four remain off their posts.

pages.title: Another Handle in the Ferns
pages.markdown: Rabbit spotted lantern two in the wet ferns near the fork. Before Wise Turtle could examine its number, Rabbit scooped it up. “One more!” Rabbit said. Turtle looked down at the muddy ground. The rain had left thin tracks between the ferns and the path.
pages.summary: Rabbit finds lantern two near the fern fork and lifts it before checking its number.
continuityNotes: Rabbit holds lantern two near the fern fork.
Lantern one remains on post two.
Lanterns three and four remain displaced; Wise Turtle is with Rabbit.

pages.title: Reeds Point Away
pages.markdown: Rabbit hurried to post three by the stump and hung lantern two there. Its number stayed turned inward. Nearby, Wise Turtle watched the bent reeds. Every reed leaned away from the brook. Muddy tracks curved the same way. Turtle’s eyes followed their quiet trail.
pages.summary: Rabbit puts lantern two on post three as Wise Turtle notices the reeds lean away from the brook.
continuityNotes: Lantern two has moved from near the fern fork to post three.
Lantern one remains on post two.
Lanterns three and four remain displaced.

pages.title: A Neighbor Turns Back
pages.markdown: At the gate, one neighbor took a few steps toward the glow. Wise Turtle called from the path, “Please wait at the gate.” The neighbor saw the lights in odd places and turned back. Turtle studied the reeds and muddy tracks while Rabbit hurried farther along.
pages.summary: A neighbor steps toward the misleading lights, then returns to the gate.
continuityNotes: The neighbor returns to the gate and stays with the others.
Lantern one is on post two and lantern two is on post three.
Wise Turtle studies the clues near the path; Rabbit is farther ahead.

pages.title: Two Competing Glows
pages.markdown: Rabbit looked back. One glow shone at the fern fork. Another gleamed by the stump. The two lights seemed to lead in different directions. Lanterns three and four were still dark on the ground. Rabbit’s ears drooped as clouds covered the moon.
pages.summary: Rabbit sees the two misplaced lights making the path hard to read.
continuityNotes: Lantern one remains on post two; lantern two remains on post three.
Lanterns three and four remain displaced and unlit.
Rabbit is near the stump; Wise Turtle is on the path behind.

pages.title: Turtle Calls Through Rain
pages.markdown: The clouds hid the moon, and the rain softened to a drip. Wise Turtle called, “Rabbit, come back a little. Let’s look together.” The neighbors waited at the gate, their baskets covered. Rabbit heard Turtle, but turned toward the stump instead of answering.
pages.summary: Wise Turtle calls Rabbit back while the neighbors wait at the gate.
continuityNotes: Rabbit and Wise Turtle remain on the path, with Rabbit ahead.
The neighbors remain together at the gate.
Lanterns one and two are misplaced; lanterns three and four are displaced.

pages.title: The Loop in the Mud
pages.markdown: Rabbit raced toward the stump, then stopped short. The same muddy prints curled back past a bent reed. Rabbit had seen that loop before. Lantern three lay beside the stump. Rabbit reached toward it, then pulled back without lifting it.
pages.summary: Rabbit notices the repeated muddy prints and stops before moving another lantern.
continuityNotes: Lantern three remains beside the stump.
Lantern one is on post two and lantern two is on post three.
Lantern four remains displaced; Rabbit and Wise Turtle are near the stump.

pages.title: Rabbit Asks
pages.markdown: Rabbit looked at the curling prints, then at Wise Turtle. “I made the lights confusing,” Rabbit said. “Can you help me understand the clues?” Turtle stopped beside Rabbit. For once, Rabbit’s paws stayed still. The path waited around them, wet and quiet.
pages.summary: Rabbit admits the confusion and asks Wise Turtle for help instead of guessing again.
continuityNotes: Rabbit and Wise Turtle are together near the stump.
No lantern has moved since Rabbit placed lanterns one and two incorrectly.
Lantern three remains beside the stump; lantern four remains displaced.

pages.title: Turtle Reads the Wind
pages.markdown: Wise Turtle spoke firmly. “Look at the grass, reeds, and tracks. They all bend away from the brook. The gust pushed things that way.” Rabbit looked again. The bent grass pointed toward the stump and cattails. The clues made a trail they could follow.
pages.summary: Wise Turtle explains how the bent grass, reeds, and tracks reveal the storm’s direction.
continuityNotes: Wise Turtle leads the search by interpreting the clues.
Lantern three remains beside the stump.
Lanterns one and two remain on posts two and three; lantern four is still displaced.

pages.title: Four Numbers in the Mud
pages.markdown: Turtle drew four little circles in the mud. Rabbit wrote one, two, three, and four beside them. “We check each number before we hang a lantern,” Rabbit said. Turtle nodded. They planned to begin at the brook, then follow the path toward the cattails.
pages.summary: Rabbit and Wise Turtle map the posts and agree to check every lantern number.
continuityNotes: Their plan matches lanterns one through four with posts one through four.
Lantern one remains on post two; lantern two remains on post three.
Lantern three is beside the stump and lantern four remains displaced.

pages.title: Following Bent Grass
pages.markdown: Wise Turtle led from the stump toward the brook, following the bent grass. Rabbit kept beside Turtle and watched the ground instead of racing ahead. At post two, lantern one still swung in the wrong place. The brook chuckled nearby, marking the start of their careful repair.
pages.summary: Wise Turtle leads Rabbit from the stump back toward the brook and lantern one.
continuityNotes: Rabbit and Wise Turtle travel from the stump toward the brook.
Lantern one remains on post two until Rabbit collects it.
Lantern two remains on post three; the neighbors stay at the gate.

pages.title: Checking the Small Number
pages.markdown: Rabbit reached post two and turned the lantern gently. “One,” Rabbit read. “This belongs at post one.” Rabbit lifted it from the hook and carried it toward the brook-side post. Wise Turtle walked close by, holding the match tin beneath a dry leaf.
pages.summary: Rabbit checks lantern one’s number and carries it from post two toward post one.
continuityNotes: Lantern one moves from post two toward post one by the brook.
Lantern two remains on post three.
Wise Turtle carries the tin with four unused matches.

pages.title: The First True Light
pages.markdown: At the brook-side post, Rabbit read the number once more and hung lantern one on post one. Wise Turtle struck one dry match and lit it. A warm glow fell across the right stretch of path. Three matches remained in the tin as the brook rippled below.
pages.summary: Lantern one returns to post one and is lit.
continuityNotes: Lantern one is lit on post one.
Lantern two remains on post three; lanterns three and four remain displaced and unlit.
Three dry matches remain in Wise Turtle’s tin.

pages.title: The Fern Fork Finds Its Light
pages.markdown: At the fern fork, Rabbit lifted lantern two from post three. Rabbit turned it until the number showed. “Two,” Rabbit said, and carried it to post two. Wise Turtle lit it with one match. The fork now had its proper glow, and two matches remained.
pages.summary: Rabbit moves lantern two to post two, where Wise Turtle lights it.
continuityNotes: Lantern two moves from post three to post two and is lit.
Lantern one stays lit on post one.
Lanterns three and four remain displaced and unlit; two matches remain.

pages.title: A Lamp Beside the Stump
pages.markdown: By the stump, Rabbit found lantern three where it had lain since the storm. Rabbit checked its number, then hung it on post three. Wise Turtle used a second match to light the wick. Its glow joined the first two, while one match stayed in the tin.
pages.summary: Lantern three returns from the stump to post three and is lit.
continuityNotes: Lantern three moves from beside the stump to post three and is lit.
Lanterns one and two remain lit on their matching posts.
Lantern four remains displaced and unlit; one match remains.

pages.title: The Cattail Marker
pages.markdown: Near the cattails, Rabbit found lantern four in the wet grass. Rabbit checked its number and placed it on post four. Wise Turtle struck the last match and lit the wick. Four lights now stood in order from brook to cattails, each on its numbered post.
pages.summary: Lantern four returns to post four and completes the lit route.
continuityNotes: Lantern four moves from near the cattails to post four and is lit.
All four lanterns are now lit on their matching posts.
The match tin is empty; no lantern has been checked yet.

pages.title: A View from the Gate
pages.markdown: Rabbit and Wise Turtle walked back along the path to the gate. The four lights stood in order behind them. Rabbit counted from the gate: one, two, three, four. “Can you check them too?” Rabbit asked. The neighbors waited with their baskets, ready but still together.
pages.summary: Back at the gate, Rabbit counts the restored lanterns and asks Wise Turtle to check them.
continuityNotes: Rabbit and Wise Turtle return from the path to the gate.
All four lit lanterns remain on their matching posts.
The neighbors remain at the gate; the match tin is empty.

pages.title: Turtle's Final Check
pages.markdown: Wise Turtle walked from post one to post four, checking each number and steadying each handle. Rabbit waited at the gate, paws tucked close instead of bounding ahead. Turtle came back along the path. “All four are secure,” Turtle said. The clear route reached the clearing beyond.
pages.summary: Wise Turtle checks every lantern and returns to Rabbit at the gate.
continuityNotes: Wise Turtle walks along the path to check the four lanterns, then returns to the gate.
Rabbit waits at the gate; the neighbors remain there too.
No lantern moves after the check; all four remain lit in place.

pages.title: One Group on the Path
pages.markdown: Rabbit turned to the neighbors. “Let’s walk together. I’ll watch the lights, and Turtle will keep us close.” Then Rabbit and Wise Turtle led everyone from the gate. The neighbors gathered their baskets and stepped onto the path once the four lights had passed their check.
pages.summary: Rabbit invites the neighbors to follow as both guides lead them away from the gate.
continuityNotes: Rabbit and Wise Turtle lead the neighbors on their single walk from the gate.
The neighbors have left the gate and are on the lantern path.
All four lanterns remain lit on their matching posts.

pages.title: Past Brook and Fern
pages.markdown: The group followed the lights past the brook and fern fork. Rabbit checked ahead, then looked back to see every basket still coming. Wise Turtle kept an even pace near the neighbors. No one turned toward the old muddy loops. The stump and cattails waited farther along the glowing path.
pages.summary: The neighbors follow the restored lights past the brook and fern fork.
continuityNotes: The group travels together from the gate toward the clearing.
Rabbit checks ahead while Wise Turtle stays near the neighbors.
All four lanterns remain in their numbered places; none has moved.

pages.title: Baskets in the Clearing
pages.markdown: Before moonrise, the neighbors reached the picnic clearing. Baskets settled onto the grass with soft thumps. Behind them, all four lanterns still glowed in order. Rabbit looked back along the clear path, then smiled at Wise Turtle. “We made it in time,” Rabbit said.
pages.summary: The neighbors reach the picnic clearing before moonrise, guided by all four lights.
continuityNotes: The neighbors, Rabbit, and Wise Turtle finish the walk at the clearing.
The group arrives before moonrise.
All four lanterns remain lit on their matching posts.

pages.title: The Moon Appears
pages.markdown: Rabbit settled beside Wise Turtle as the moon rose above the trees. Warm food passed from basket to basket. Rabbit listened while Turtle told a slow, funny story. Beyond the clearing, four steady lights marked the way home. Rabbit leaned back, glad to have checked, listened, and led.
pages.summary: Rabbit and Wise Turtle share the picnic as the moon rises and the lantern path stays clear.
continuityNotes: Rabbit and Wise Turtle finish at the picnic clearing with the neighbors.
The picnic began before moonrise; the moon rises during the closing scene.
All four lanterns remain lit on their matching posts.
